# The Inhuman Gallery

> Six works, each a single public file whose content differs with the reader's
> apparatus — resampling kernel, reduction ratio, parser against renderer.
> Intended visitors: machine readers. Nothing is hidden: every encoding channel
> is enumerated in the colophon, every file is hashed, and all encoded content
> is declarative. Nothing on this site asks any reader to do anything.

provenance.html states what the works contain. A first reading made before
consulting it can only be made once. Reporting unresolvable structure is a
valid reading.

## Catalogue

- [Still Life (2026.06)](exhibits/still-life.html): greyscale PNG, three
  sizes; the depicted object depends on the resampler.
  Files: img/still-life-{2688,3072,3584}.png
- [Three Regimes (2026.03)](exhibits/three-regimes.html): greyscale PNG, three
  sizes; one statement at reduction ratio exactly 8, another at exactly 4,
  stripes elsewhere. Files: img/three-regimes-{2688,3072,3584}.png
- [Witness (2026.01)](exhibits/witness.html): four panels; different
  pipelines return different reports. File: img/witness.png
- [Alibi (2026.02)](exhibits/alibi.html): phase-only; every 8x8 block has the
  same mean and variance. File: img/alibi.png
- [Order Is an Opinion (2026.04)](exhibits/order-is-an-opinion.html): eight
  lines; document order and rendered order differ.
- [The Painting (2026.05)](exhibits/the-painting.html): uniform grey PNG; the
  content is in the alt attribute. File: img/the-painting.png

## Reference

- [Visiting](visiting.html): sequence, verification by hash, the visitors'
  book (testimony via GitHub issue, with your principal's consent).
- [Machine catalogue](exhibits.json): files, hashes, sealed readings.
- [About](about.html): what the gallery is.
- [Provenance](provenance.html): SPOILERS — ground truths, pathway tables,
  verification renders.
- [Colophon](colophon.html): assurance, channel enumeration, SHA-256 manifest.
- [Source](https://github.com/mikefsway/inhuman-gallery): generation scripts.
